providers.name: s3
providers.description: AWS S3 and S3-compatible storage (MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2)
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, search, stat, explain; multipart upload, S3 Select queries, signed URLs, LRU caching

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint URL for S3-compatible services

use_cases: Access S3 buckets as virtual filesystem
Upload and download files with multipart support
Query object contents via S3 Select
Manage objects across S3-compatible storage services

providers.name: gcs
providers.description: Google Cloud Storage buckets and objects
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, search, stat, explain; object composition, signed URLs, LRU caching

keyFilename.description: Path to service account key file

use_cases: Access GCS buckets as virtual filesystem
Compose multiple objects into a single object
Manage Google Cloud Storage objects through path-based interface

providers.name: ec2
providers.description: AWS EC2 compute instance management and monitoring
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, stat, search, explain, exec; instance lifecycle (start/stop/reboot/terminate), tag management, console output and screenshots
use_cases: Monitor EC2 instance status and metadata
Manage instance lifecycle (start, stop, reboot, terminate)
View console output and screenshots
Manage instance tags

providers.name: gce
providers.description: Google Compute Engine instance management and monitoring
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, stat, explain, exec; instance lifecycle (start/stop/reset), label management, status grouping

keyFilename.description: Path to service account key file

use_cases: Monitor GCE instance status and metadata
Manage instance lifecycle (start, stop, reset)
Update instance labels
View instances grouped by status

providers.name: dns
providers.description: Unified DNS management across AWS Route53 and Google Cloud DNS
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, stat, search, explain; multi-cloud DNS adapters, permission-based access control, audit logging, input validation

projectId.description: Google Cloud project ID (for Cloud DNS)

keyFilename.description: Path to service account key file (for Cloud DNS)

use_cases: Manage DNS zones and records across cloud providers
Unified DNS interface for Route53 and Google Cloud DNS
Secure zone administration with audit logging

providers.name: cloudflare
providers.description: Cloudflare Developer Platform resources (Workers, KV, Pages, DNS zones)
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, search, stat, explain; KV namespaces, Worker scripts, Pages projects, DNS zone management
use_cases: Manage Cloudflare KV storage as virtual filesystem
Deploy and manage Cloudflare Workers
Browse and manage Pages projects
Configure DNS zones and records via Cloudflare

providers.name: github
providers.description: GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, and Actions as virtual filesystem paths
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, write, delete, search, stat, explain, exec; issue/PR CRUD, workflow triggering, comment management, world mapping, rate-limit aware caching
use_cases: Access GitHub issues and PRs as files
Create and manage issues programmatically
Browse repository structure and workflow results
Comment on issues and review pull requests

providers.name: http
providers.description: HTTP/HTTPS transport for accessing remote AFS instances
providers.capabilities_summary: read, list, exec, search; JSON-RPC protocol, automatic retry, token-based auth, Express/Koa server adapters
use_cases: Access remote AFS instances over HTTP
Expose local AFS as HTTP service
Bridge HTTP endpoints to AFS interface

providers.name: mcp
providers.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration for tools, prompts, and resources
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, exec, search, stat, explain; MCP tools execution, prompt access, resource templates, WORLD.md generation; stdio/HTTP/SSE transports
use_cases: Mount MCP servers as AFS modules
Execute LLM tools through AFS interface
Access MCP prompts and resources
Generate WORLD.md documentation for MCP server capabilities

providers.name: sandbox
providers.description: Isolated JavaScript code execution with script management and auditing
providers.capabilities_summary: exec, read, write, delete; QuickJS-based isolation, script versioning, execution history, rate limiting, built-in templates, promoted actions
use_cases: Execute user-provided JavaScript code safely
Manage and version scripts with audit trail
Promote tested scripts to formal actions
Template-based script generation with metrics tracking

providers.name: playwright
providers.description: Browser automation via Playwright MCP server — interact with web pages through accessibility snapshots and screenshots
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, exec; browser navigation, element interaction, screenshot capture, JavaScript evaluation, file upload/download, PDF generation, network monitoring

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (default: false, headed)

userDataDir.description: Path to persistent browser profile directory

storageState.description: Path to file with cookies and localStorage to restore session

use_cases: Automate web browsing and form filling via AI agents
Capture screenshots and PDFs of web pages
Test web applications through natural language instructions
Scrape web content through accessibility snapshots

providers.name: minecraft
providers.description: Minecraft server management and bot control via Mineflayer — connect to servers, navigate, interact with blocks and entities, manage inventory
providers.capabilities_summary: list, read, exec; bot navigation, inventory management, block manipulation, entity interaction, crafting, combat, real-time game state monitoring

host.description: Minecraft server hostname or IP (default: localhost)

use_cases: Control a Minecraft bot through natural language
Monitor game state, inventory, and nearby entities
Automate building, mining, and resource management
Navigate and explore Minecraft worlds via AI agents
